followup:
Final council round. Review these Sol resolutions to your REQUEST_CHANGES. Return ACCEPT if they close the material gaps; otherwise list only unresolved material disagreements.

1. Command Center route and history decision
- Commit uses the existing "/" route so reload, links, and browser/PWA history remain coherent.
- Add an explicit standalone-compact navigation intent/policy to the route reconciliation boundary. When the destination is Command Center/new-thread, reconciliation is skipped and the focused pane/layout remain untouched. This policy is impossible to activate outside standalone compact mode.
- Long-swipe preview does not change the route. Only successful settlement commits navigate to "/". Cancel leaves route/history unchanged.
- Commit pushes one history entry. Browser/back or a left swipe from Command Center returns to the saved prior location and focused pane. Direct launch/reload at "/" has no return target and behaves as ordinary Command Center.
- Opening a recent or submitting the composer commits a normal thread route, focusing an existing pane or explicitly creating/reusing a pane according to existing policy.
2. Sidebar scope decision
- Remove/disable right-swipe and wheel-to-open only when the standalone-compact capability is true. Safari tabs and all desktop surfaces retain current behavior. Button open and drawer swipe-to-close remain everywhere.
3. Header ownership decision
- Add a dedicated delivery stage before the transition host. In standalone compact PWA mode only, AppLayout suppresses its shared header and each complete destination surface owns header/body/footer/accessory chrome inside the transition boundary.
- Outside that capability, AppLayout ownership remains unchanged. Add an invariant/test that exactly one header/toolbar/composer owner exists in idle, preview, commit, cancel, and interrupted states.
4. Preview performance decision
- Pointer movement never synchronously mounts a full thread view.
- Idle time prewarms lightweight inert previews for previous/next destinations from already-cached metadata and a stable content shell; no terminal/plugin panel, autofocus, secondary drawer, live subscription duplication, or new fetch is allowed.
- Gesture start uses the ready lightweight preview; if unavailable, it uses a stable route shell. Full target content mounts only after commit while the outgoing surface remains visually stable until target readiness.
- Extract pane-order traversal/getAdjacentPaneId for compact use; do not call the split-only command handlers.
5. Motion decision
- New shared compact-navigation tokens are 250ms and cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Existing non-PWA sidebar behavior retains 220ms/current curve.
- Standalone compact panel CSS uses 400ms open/350ms close where BB owns the settle; Vaul's finger tracking remains direct and interruptible.
6. Preview focus discipline
- Preview surfaces are inert and receive explicit interactive=false/suppressAutofocus/suppressSecondaryPanel behavior. Root composer autofocus and secondary panels activate only after successful commit.
7. Long-swipe ambiguity
- Velocity may complete a short adjacent-tab swipe, but can never promote it to Command Center. Command Center requires crossing the 65-70% physical distance threshold plus the visible threshold cue. Add high-velocity short-fling acceptance tests.

Delivery sequence becomes:
A contracts/capability/reconciliation policy;
B compact pane traversal and non-destructive focus;
C standalone compact header ownership migration;
D gesture ownership/coordinator;
E lightweight preview + transition host/chrome lifecycle;
F Command Center route/history round-trip;
G panel arbitration and compact sheet sizing;
H workspace switcher, accessibility, touch/craft/loading polish;
I automated and older-iPhone standalone QA.

No implementation or files changes in council.
